title: Does This Gradient Spark Joy?
abstract: arXiv:2603.20526v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Policy gradient computes a backward pass for every sample, although the backward pass is expensive and most samples carry little learning value. The Delightful Policy Gradient (DG) scores learning value in the forward pass with \emph{delight}, the product of advantage and surprisal (negative log-probability). We introduce the \emph{Kondo gate}, which compares delight against a compute price and pays for a backward pass only when the sample is worth it; sweeping the price traces a quality--cost trade-off. On MNIST, keeping 3\% of gradient terms learns faster than standard policy gradient even when backward passes are free, and nearly matches full DG. In bandits, zero-price gating preserves the expected gradient direction and removes its perpendicular noise, delight ranks samples more reliably than additive mixes of value and surprise, and a rare action with high reward variance marks where delight fails. On transformer token rev

translated_title: 这个梯度能带来喜悦吗？
translated_abstract: 策略梯度方法为每个样本都要执行一次反向传播，然而反向传播代价高昂，且大多数样本几乎没有学习价值。愉悦策略梯度在前向传播中就用“愉悦度”来评估样本的学习价值，愉悦度是优势与惊讶度（负对数概率）的乘积。我们提出了“近藤门控”，它将愉悦度与一个计算价格进行比较，只有当样本值得时才为其支付反向传播的开销；通过调节该价格可以刻画出质量与成本之间的权衡曲线。在MNIST上，即使反向传播完全免费，仅保留3%的梯度项也比标准策略梯度学习得更快，并且几乎能达到完整DG的效果。在老虎机任务中，零价格门控能够保持期望梯度方向并消除其垂直方向上的噪声；与价值和惊讶度的加性混合相比，愉悦度对样本的排序更加可靠；而具有高奖励方差的罕见动作则揭示了愉悦度失效的场景。在Transformer的词元反……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 论文提出愉悦策略梯度（DG），在前向传播中用优势与惊讶度的乘积“愉悦度”评估样本的学习价值，并通过“近藤门控”只为值得的样本执行昂贵的反向传播，从而以极少的计算实现更快的学习。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Delightful Policy Gradient (DG), which scores each sample's learning value in the forward pass via "delight" (advantage × surprisal) and uses a "Kondo gate" to pay for a backward pass only when a sample is worth it, achieving faster learning with far less computation.
